values.quote: becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 4 seconds

mechanics.claim: Thundering Smash's bonus damage cannot critically strike, but the base attack damage can.
mechanics.quote: ''Thundering Smash's'' bonus damage cannot {{tip|critically strike}}; the base damage of the attack '''can''', however.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack damage applies life steal.
Thundering Smash resets Volibear's basic attack timer and does not put the basic attack on cooldown, effectively granting a double attack reset.
mechanics.quote: ''Thundering Smash {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Volibear's''' basic attack timer.''

mechanics.claim: The ability deals basic damage but is also tagged as spell damage, triggering spell effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Thundering Smash'' deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack still applies its damage/stun even if its dash is interrupted, unless Volibear dies.
mechanics.quote: ''Thundering Smash'' will still apply its effects to the target even if the {{tip|dash}} is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, but not if he goes into {{tip|resurrection}}.

mechanics.claim: If the target becomes untargetable during the windup, the stun and damage do not apply.
mechanics.quote: The windup for the attack completes even if the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}} but the {{tip|stun}} and damage do not apply.

mechanics.claim: If Volibear becomes immobilized or polymorphed while active, the effect ends early and the cooldown resets.
mechanics.quote: If '''Volibear''' becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}} by an enemy during ''Thundering Smash'', the effect ends prematurely and the {{sti|cooldown}} is reset.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts after the effect (attack) resolves, not on cast.
